description: This grouped bar chart illustrates the CoLeG-R (%) performance across three different LLaMA-2 models under four distinct conditions. The horizontal category axis displays the models in order of increasing size: LLaMA-2-7B, LLaMA-2-13B, and LLaMA-2-70B. The vertical value axis is labeled "CoLeG-R (%)" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, with numeric tick marks at regular intervals of 10. Within each of the three model categories, there is a group of four vertical bars arranged side-by-side. According to the legend in the bottom right corner, the first bar is light blue with diagonal hatching (top-left to bottom-right) and is accompanied in the legend by a solid grey rectangle without a text label. The second bar is light orange with horizontal stripes, labeled "+ SFT on $D_0$". The third bar is light purple with diagonal hatching (bottom-left to top-right), labeled "+ SFT on $D_0, D_1$". The fourth bar is solid light pink, labeled "+ SFT on $D_0, D_1, D_2$". In the LLaMA-2-7B group, the values start at approximately 66% for both the light blue hatched and light orange striped bars (representing the shortest bars in the chart), rising to roughly 81% for the light purple hatched bar and 84% for the solid light pink bar. For the LLaMA-2-13B group, the light blue hatched bar is at about 70%, the light orange striped bar is near 74%, the light purple hatched bar reaches the highest value in the chart at approximately 85%, and the solid light pink bar is at 80%. In the LLaMA-2-70B group, the values are more clustered, with the light blue hatched bar at roughly 81%, the light orange striped bar at 82%, the light purple hatched bar at 84%, and the solid light pink bar at 83%. The categories are sorted by model size, and visual distinction is provided through the use of distinct colors and patterns for each condition.
